sentence: This project builds computational tools that measure patterns of brain cell activity in laboratory models made from patient cells in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.
This project uses a mouse genetic model to test whether alcohol drinking during adolescence worsens symptoms of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
This project studies how rumination after interpersonal stress leads to depression in adolescent girls across three time points.
This project studies how DNA methylation controls immune responses after stem cell transplant, to separate harmful graft-vs-host disease from graft-vs-tumor activity.
This project tries to find out how endothelial cells that line blood vessels gain organ-specific functions so they can help repair damaged organs.
This project images the brains of rats before and after long exposure to oxycodone to find brain differences linked to addiction-like behaviors.
This project provides computing tools and custom software that help vision researchers analyze large datasets, including retinal images and electronic health records.
This project develops medicines that target glioma tumors while sparing healthy cells in children and young adults.
This project builds chemical reagents to image copper in biological systems and tries to find out how copper contributes to health and disease, including cancer.
This project develops deep learning methods that measure heart movement in magnetic resonance images to predict which patients respond to pacing.
This project maps how heterochromatin forms and spreads during early embryogenesis in Drosophila melanogaster.
This project builds a molecular imaging technology that shows which molecules sit near each other in cells and tissues.
This project uses metabolic imaging to evaluate the extent of glioma, the blood-brain-barrier and response to treatment in patients.
This project provides single-cell sequencing support to trace cell lineages and measure how mutant human and mouse cells respond to stressors.
This project studies how social determinants of health and cancer together affect accelerated aging, and whether physical activity changes that link.
This project studies how a molecular switch decides whether human pericytes become osteogenic or adipogenic cells.
This project builds a machine-learning tool that uses electronic health records to identify patients at risk of opioid overdose or opioid use disorder.
This project develops course material that teaches researchers to use large datasets to study how the human microbiome relates to health and disease.
This project studies how the microbiome raises the risk of infection after joint replacement for osteoarthritis.
This project provides genomic analysis services, including sequencing and spatial genomics, and data analysis for cancer research.
